description: Austin Water publishes wastewater-treatment quantities by year, month and treatment plant. The source describes the quantities in millions of gallons, and the schema identifies MG Treated, plant, month, year and type of water. These monthly plant-level volumes can support wastewater demand and treatment-throughput models. They do not establish rated treatment capacity, peak-hour flow, pollutant concentration or spare capacity. The inspected catalogue metadata does not identify the first and last observation months or explain the type-of-water categories. The October 2025 data-update timestamp is retained as an update date only. Aggregated monthly quantities do not establish daily peaks, and the definition of a gallon was not independently checked beyond the provider wording. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Austin.
